response.sql: WITH matched_fees AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune AS order_type, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS average_rebate FROM matched_fees), grouped AS (SELECT orderslink, order_type, AVG(rebtotal) AS average_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS average_relative_gap FROM matched_fees GROUP BY orderslink, order_type) SELECT g.orderslink, g.order_type, g.average_rebate, g.average_relative_gap, g.average_rebate - a.average_rebate AS above_overall_average FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE g.average_rebate > a.average_rebate ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC, g.orderslink, g.order_type LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is calculated across fee rows with matching orders. A zero fee rate makes that row's relative gap undefined, so AVG excludes it.
